LanguageData.LP_HealingHands.label: healing hands
LanguageData.LP_HealingHands.description: Lay hands on an ally: each wound heals (Medicine level/2 + Social level/2). Can't regrow lost limbs. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_RadiantSoulLeap.label: radiant soul
LanguageData.LP_RadiantSoulLeap.description: Spread wings of light and leap far away. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_RadiantSoulLeap.verbProperties.label: leap
LanguageData.LP_NecroticShroud.label: necrotic shroud
LanguageData.LP_NecroticShroud.description: Cloak yourself in the shadow of death: living enemies within 4 cells flee in terror for 8 seconds. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_InfernalPact.label: devil's bargain
LanguageData.LP_InfernalPact.description: Haggle with the devil: mood -10 (3 days) in exchange for +20% shooting and melee damage and +20% psyfocus gain for 24 hours; then consciousness -10% for 12 hours. Cooldown 5 days.
